summary: Nigeria immigration law serves two distinct diaspora client groups: Nigerians abroad who want to understand or formalize their retained Nigerian citizenship, and non-Nigerians (including African Americans) who want to live or invest in Nigeria via CERPAC or NIPC investor routes. This directory covers 10 verified immigration lawyers and solicitors across Lagos and Abuja.
contextNote: Nigeria has two distinct immigration use cases for the diaspora. First: Nigerians in the diaspora hold Nigerian citizenship by birth and do not lose it by acquiring foreign nationality. However, they often need legal help understanding their retained citizenship rights, obtaining Nigerian passports, and navigating dual nationality documentation. Second: Non-Nigerians (including African Americans) relocating to Nigeria have no Right of Abode equivalent. They must use the CERPAC system (a residency card for foreigners) obtained after entry on an STR (Subject to Regularization) visa, or qualify for an investor permit through the Nigerian Investment Promotion Commission (NIPC). Both routes require qualified legal guidance due to the complexity of Nigerian Immigration Service bureaucracy.

firms.name: Okafor & Associates
firms.description: Lagos firm with a strong corporate and diaspora immigration practice. Handles NIPC investor permit applications for non-Nigerians who want to live and invest in Lagos, alongside dual citizenship documentation for returning Nigerians. Known for navigating the Nigerian Investment Promotion Commission process efficiently, which is the primary legal route for African Americans and others wanting long-term residence in Nigeria.

Explicitly addresses the question of what immigration options exist for non-Nigerians who want to call Lagos home. Free initial consultations available. Confirmed Google Ads targeting diaspora audiences. Known for honest framing: they tell clients upfront that Nigeria has no Right of Abode equivalent and explain what realistically exists.

Well-suited for clients who are starting businesses and need immigration tied to their corporate structure. Active Linkedin presence with immigration guides for professionals and investors.
